name: (Tensorial) ER = EPR

phase_0.boundary_condition: The ER=EPR duality: the equivalence between quantum entanglement and wormhole geometry closes the system.

VINIT.justification: Initial state: no particles, no spacetime geometry, a pre-geometric void.

TANCH.justification: Terminal anchor: the fixed-point equivalence that contains the whole system.

AFWD.justification: Forward morphism: time evolution of the quantum state via unitary dynamics.

AREV.justification: Reverse morphism: time evolution of the wormhole geometry via gravitational dynamics.

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining: the process links quantum and geometric descriptions.

IMSCRIB.justification: Identity: the duality refers to and validates itself.

FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication: the vacuum fluctuates to create an entangled pair (A and B).

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication: the entangled pair annihilates back into the vacuum, recovering the original state.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch: experimental verification of nonlocal correlations.

EVALF.justification: Negative branch: loss of entanglement due to environmental interaction.

ENGAGR.justification: Both simultaneously: entanglement and geometry are held as equivalent descriptions without reduction.

IFIX.justification: Permanent, append-only record: a measurement collapses the wave function and fixes the classical state.

phase_3.void_description: Quantum vacuum: no particles, no spacetime geometry, a pre-geometric void.
phase_3.true_description: Entangled state: nonlocal correlations present, Bell inequality violated.
phase_3.false_description: Separable state: no entanglement, classical correlations only.
phase_3.both_description: ER=EPR duality: entanglement and wormhole geometry are two aspects of the same phenomenon.

steps.domain_action: Quantum vacuum state, before any particles or geometry exist.
Vacuum fluctuation creates an entangled pair of particles (A and B).
Entangled pair evolves forward in time via Schrödinger equation.
Wormhole geometry evolves backward in time via Einstein equations.
ER=EPR duality holds: the quantum state and geometry are equivalent descriptions.
Entangled pair annihilates, returning to the quantum vacuum.
The process composes as a closed loop: vacuum to pair to vacuum.
The duality is self-referential: it describes the equivalence of its own two aspects.
The duality is affirmed by experimental evidence (e.g., quantum teleportation).
A measurement event records the quantum state, fixing it in the classical domain.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Quantum field theory and general relativity
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Black hole information paradox and its resolution

phase_6.cycle_cost: Energy of maintaining entanglement and spacetime curvature
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Quantum vacuum with zero energy after annihilation
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The process is unitary and reversible; no information is lost.
